sql:
SELECT 
  fish_date_doy as doy,
  ROUND(AVG(CAST(yt AS FLOAT) / CAST(anglers AS FLOAT)), 3) as yt_per_angler,
  COUNT(*) as trips,
  SUM(yt) as total_yt,
  SUM(anglers) as total_anglers
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season = 6
GROUP BY fish_date_doy
ORDER BY doy
LIMIT 70
